meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与信息安全分析师在构建多智能体系统时，当需全链路可观测与安全审计，请用此技能。它自动收集操作日志，生成可追溯证据链与向量索引，开箱即用实现系统审计与精准回放，让Agent运行安全透明。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集Agent操作日志，构建可溯源证据链，实现安全审计与精准回放。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多智能体系统，需要全链路可观测与安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Collect agent operation logs as evidence chains for audit and replay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building multi-agent systems and need full observability and audit trails.

howto.what: 它自动记录多智能体系统里每次分发、扫描、解析与卡片生成事件，按 trace_id 串成证据链并建向量索引，运行脚本产出 trace.jsonl 与 trace_summary.json。
howto.when: 当多智能体系统需要全链路可观测与安全审计时触发：由各官署在关键操作节点调用，或经事件总线异步推送，也可运行 run_provenance.py 执行 provenance 阶段。

say.text: 运行 run_provenance.py，把这次全链路事件回流到证据链。
say.note: 写入全链路事件与四色卡片

say.text: 按 trace_id 检索这次运行的历史证据。
say.note: 返回该 trace 的证据链与向量索引条目

say.text: 查一下最近时间窗内的官署事件记录。
say.note: 按时间窗返回证据快照，可能标注 stale

howto.what_en: It records every dispatch, scan, parse and card-generation event in your multi-agent system, chains them into a trace_id evidence chain with a vector index, and the script outputs trace.jsonl and trace_summary.json.
howto.when_en: Use it when a multi-agent system needs end-to-end observability and security audit: agencies call it at key operation nodes, push events over the bus, or you run run_provenance.py.

say_en.text: Run run_provenance.py to write this run's events into the evidence chain.
say_en.note: Writes full-chain events and four-color cards

say_en.text: Query this run's evidence by trace_id.
say_en.note: Returns the evidence chain and vector index entries

say_en.text: List agency events in the latest time window.
say_en.note: Returns the latest snapshot, may be marked stale
